title.zh: 陕西Cloudina：寒武纪以前的带壳动物
title.en: Cloudina in Shaanxi: shells before the Cambrian

answer.zh: 陕西的Cloudina化石记录提醒我们，动物带壳的故事在寒武纪开始以前就已经展开。
answer.en: A Cloudina fossil occurrence from Shaanxi reminds us that the story of animal shells began before the Cambrian.

explanation.zh: Cloudina是具有管状壳体的早期动物，不能用三叶虫来代替。PBDB将这处采集记录的原鉴定与当前接受名都列为Cloudina hartmannae，并追溯到一篇讨论壳体钻孔与捕食关系的论文。它把化石、地点和文献连接起来，但数据库的整个埃迪卡拉纪年龄包络，并不表示Cloudina从6.35亿年前起就在这里连续生活。
explanation.en: Cloudina was an early animal with a tubular shell, not a trilobite. PBDB records both the original identification and the currently accepted name here as Cloudina hartmannae, tracing the occurrence to a paper on shell borings and predator-prey relationships. This connects fossils, a locality and a publication. The database's whole-Ediacaran age envelope does not mean Cloudina lived here continuously from 635 million years ago.

text.zh: PBDB记录occ:510810、采集记录col:51735给出Cloudina hartmannae及陕西的现代坐标，并引用Hua、Pratt与Zhang的2003年论文。
text.en: PBDB occurrence occ:510810, collection col:51735, supplies Cloudina hartmannae, modern coordinates in Shaanxi and a reference to Hua, Pratt and Zhang's 2003 paper.

text.zh: 原记录的地层标签为Ediacaran，数值包络为635至538.8 Ma；这是一段地层年龄范围，不是单件化石的精确测年。
text.en: The original stratigraphic label is Ediacaran, with an envelope of 635-538.8 Ma. This is a stratigraphic range, not a precise date for an individual fossil.

caveats.zh: 540 Ma是范围内的浏览年代，仍早于现行寒武纪起点；不能据宽包络断言每一年都存在该动物。
caveats.en: 540 Ma is a browsing age within the envelope and still predates the current Cambrian boundary; the broad range does not establish presence in every year.

caveats.zh: 本条依据已归档的PBDB记录，未重新核读原论文，也不据壳体钻孔题名补画特定捕食者。
caveats.en: This entry uses the archived PBDB record; the original paper was not reread, and its title does not justify adding a particular predator.

timeNote.zh: 保留原始635至538.8 Ma地层包络；约5.4亿年前的地图位置不等于这件化石恰好生活在那一年。
timeNote.en: The original 635-538.8 Ma stratigraphic envelope is retained. A map position at about 540 million years ago is not an exact date for this fossil.

name.zh: 陕西省文献采集地点，中国

precision.zh: PBDB标为small collection的文献采集位置；沿用公开坐标，实测误差未知，小数位数不代表GPS精度。
precision.en: A published collection position classified by PBDB as 'small collection'. Public coordinates are retained; measured uncertainty is unknown and decimal places do not establish GPS accuracy.

title.zh: Proterocladus antiquus · 中国辽宁石垒村南芬组
title.en: Proterocladus antiquus · Shileicun, Nanfen Formation, Liaoning, China

answer.zh: 多细胞绿藻（Chlorophyta），不是陆生植物。
answer.en: A multicellular green alga (Chlorophyta), not a land plant.

explanation.zh: Tang 等人 2020 年论文标题称其约十亿年；PBDB 地层包络很宽。
explanation.en: The title of Tang et al. (2020) describes it as one billion years old; the PBDB stratigraphic envelope is broad.

text.en: PBDB occ:1627075, col:230319, ref:85018; stratigraphic envelope 1200–720 Ma.

caveats.zh: 地层包络不是单件化石的精确年龄，也不能证明它恰好生活在所选切片时刻。
caveats.en: The stratigraphic envelope is not the exact age of an individual fossil and does not establish presence at the selected slice instant.

caveats.zh: 原创岩石图标仅标示化石记录，不描绘生物、标本或其形态；未复制论文图像。
caveats.en: The original rock icon marks a fossil record; it does not depict the organism, specimen or its morphology. No paper figures were copied.

timeNote.zh: 原地层包络 1200–720 Ma；1000 Ma 只是选定的浏览切片。
timeNote.en: Original stratigraphic envelope 1200–720 Ma; 1000 Ma is only the selected browsing slice.

explanation.en: PBDB assigns the collection to an Ediacaran stratigraphic envelope.

text.en: PBDB occ:1611536, col:200480, ref:83052; stratigraphic envelope 635–538.8 Ma.

caveats.en: The stratigraphic envelope is not the exact age of an individual fossil and does not establish presence at the selected slice instant.
